cycle.docs:
**boolean**: Whether or not to set the number to its maximum value when the decrement pushes the value below its minimum value. This will only work when the number component uses a minimum and maximum value. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#shorthand)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the number component to update.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#shorthand)*

decrement.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) for decrementing a number value by its step size (default: 1).

cycle.docs:
**boolean**: Whether or not to set the number to its minimum value when the increment pushes the value beyond its maximum value. This will only work when the number component uses a minimum and maximum value. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#shorthand)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the number component to update.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#shorthand)*

increment.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) for incrementing a number value by its step size (default: 1).

cycle.docs:
**bool**: Can be used with `DECREMENT` or `INCREMENT` to specify whether or not to wrap around the value when respectively the minimum or maximum value of the number is exceeded.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#or-templated-lambda)*

operation.docs:
**string**: What operation to perform on the number component. One of `TO_MIN`, `TO_MAX`, `DECREMENT` or `INCREMENT` (case insensitive). When writing a lambda for this field, then return one of the following enum values: `NUMBER_OP_TO_MIN`, `NUMBER_OP_TO_MAX`, `NUMBER_OP_DECREMENT` or `NUMBER_OP_INCREMENT`.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#or-templated-lambda)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the number to update.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#or-templated-lambda)*

operation.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) that can be used to perform an operation on a number component (set to minimum or maximum value, decrement, increment), using a generic templatable action call.

value.docs:
**float**: The value to set the number to.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#numberset-action)*

set.docs: You can also set the number for the template number from elsewhere in your YAML file with the [`number.set` Action](https://esphome.io/components/number#number-set-action).

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the number component to update.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#shorthand)*

to_max.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) setting a number to its maximum value, given a number component that has a maximum value defined for it.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the number component to update.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#shorthand)*

to_min.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) setting a number to its minimum value, given a number component that has a minimum value defined for it.

atm90e32.docs:
`number` entities can be configured to provide calibration voltage & current reference values at runtime.

*See also: [ATM90E32 Power Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/atm90e32#number)*

bl0940.docs:
The `bl0940` number platform allows for online calibration of the sensor readings.

*See also: [Belling BL0940 Energy Monitor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/bl0940#number)*

homeassistant.docs:
The `homeassistant` number platform allows you to create a number that is synchronized with Home Assistant. Min, Max and Step are not configurable for this platform because they are taken from the Home Assistant entity.

*See also: [Home Assistant Number](https://esphome.io/components/number/homeassistant)*

ld2410.docs:
The `ld2410` number allows you to control the configuration of your [Ld2410](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2410/).

*See also: [LD2410 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2410#number)*

ld2412.docs:
The `ld2412` number allows you to control the configuration of your module.

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#number)*

ld2450.docs:
The `ld2450` number platform allows you to control the presence timeout and zone area configuration of your [Ld2450](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2450/).

*See also: [LD2450 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2450#number)*

ld6002b.docs:
The `ld6002b` number platform lets you configure timing and detection areas.

*See also: [LD6002B 3D Presence Radar](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld6002b#number)*

seeed_mr24hpc1.docs:
The `seeed_mr24hpc1` number allows you to control the configuration.

*See also: [Seeed Studio MR24HPC1 mmWave (Kit)](https://esphome.io/components/seeed_mr24hpc1#number)*

template.docs:
The `template` number platform allows you to create a number with templated values using [lambdas](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda).

*See also: [Template Number](https://esphome.io/components/number/template)*

in_range.docs: This condition passes if the state of the given number is inside a range.

above.docs:
**float**: The minimum for the condition.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#in-a-trigger)*

below.docs:
**float**: The maximum for the condition.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#in-a-trigger)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the number to set.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#numberset-action)*

device_class.docs:
**string**: The device class for the number. See [https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/number/#device-class](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/number/#device-class) for a list of available options.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#optional-variables)*

mode.docs:
**string**: Defines how the number should be displayed in the frontend. See [https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/number/#properties](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/number/#properties) for a list of available options. Defaults to `"auto"`.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#optional-variables)*

on_value.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a new value is published. See [`on_value`](https://esphome.io/components/number#number-on_value).

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#optional-variables)*

above.docs:
**float**: The minimum for the trigger.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#optional-variables)*

below.docs:
**float**: The maximum for the trigger.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#optional-variables)*

on_value_range.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a published value transition from outside to a range to inside. See [`on_value_range`](https://esphome.io/components/number#number-on_value_range).

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#optional-variables)*

unit_of_measurement.docs:
**string**: Manually set the unit of measurement for the number.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#optional-variables)*

id.docs:
**string**: Manually specify the ID for code generation. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

*See also: [Number Component](https://esphome.io/components/number#optional-variables)*

source_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The source number to observe.

*See also: [Number Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/number#configuration-variables)*
